svg.title: The emperor did not smile
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene: in the palace courtyard, five children stand in a row. In front of four of them is a pot full of flowers — pink peonies, yellow chrysanthemums, red peonies and purple flowers. At the end of the row Ping holds his blue-and-white pot of bare soil. On the left, the old emperor stands looking along the row, not smiling.
